name: claude-trading-skills
description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
one_liner: A set of plug-in skills for Claude Code that turn it into a personal trading-research assistant — charting, screeners, economic calendars — built by one trader for their own process, not a signal service or profit promise.
buyer: An individual long-term investor who already uses Claude Code and wants to add structured market-review habits, not a professional trading desk.
business_use_cases: A retail investor installs the skills to standardize their weekly market review and trade journaling instead of doing it in spreadsheets.
A finance content creator uses it as the backbone for a paid course teaching 'how to build an AI-assisted trading workflow'.
A small fintech uses the open skills as a reference implementation when building their own in-house research assistant.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid course or community teaching people to set up and extend the workflow for their own portfolio
Offer paid custom-skill development for traders who want it adapted to a specific market or strategy

steal_this: The repo itself explicitly isn't a product — the honest weekend build is a paid 'setup and customize your AI trading workflow' service for individual investors, not a signal-selling business, since the author is clear this isn't financial advice.
